messages:
mira: opened a small hotfix docs PR to add the status page permalink + a short customer workaround for the failover last night. Need 1-2 reviewers and a green preview before the 10:00 customer sync.
raul: drop the PR link?
mira: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/612 — edits: add status.redwood.com permalink to /operational/incidents, Known Issue about KV-cache invalidation during autoscaler failover, a brief ops workaround, and Rust + Go SDK retry examples. Also added a short migration note for older SDK clients.
anya: i can take the prose pass. quick FYI: docs-preview has been throwing a link-checker false positive for external permalinks. might need a tweak.
docs-bot: docs-preview failed for PR #612 — build error: link-checker: external link https://status.redwood.com/incidents/2025-03-14-inference-failover (HTTP 404). Full log at https://ci.redwood.com/build/11820
sre_kate: the public status slug is actually with a trailing "-followup" suffix. correct permalink: https://status.redwood.com/incidents/2025-03-14-inference-failover-followup. use that and remove the trailing slash variant to avoid the checker.
mira: updated the permalink and pushed. also added a short "If you see queued requests" line for Dedicated customers.
raul: nit: Rust sample should use a timeout on the request future. suggest:
```rust
let client = Redwood::new();
let resp = client.generate("redwood-7b", "...", Some(Duration::from_secs(120))).await?;
```
mark as rust block.
mira: added the rust timeout example and a Go snippet with context timeout. pushed.
l10n_tom: small request from localization — we need an i18n-friendly copy for the customer blurb and to surface the status permalink in the Spanish and Japanese docs folders. can you add a short translatable string and a TODO for l10n?
mira: added a "Customer note (translatable)" placeholder and created includes/incidents/status-permalink-i18n.md with the English string and TODO markers for es/ja. pushed.
docs-bot: Preview published: https://deploy-preview-612--docs.redwood.com — please review the rendered Known Issue, SDK blocks, and the i18n placeholder.
deploy-bot: note: preview build emitted a warning about an internal admin API snippet referenced in the ops include; please confirm it's not leaked to the public doc.
mira: moved the admin snippet to /internal-runbooks and replaced with "Ops-only: contact SRE for cache-clear steps" placeholder. pushed.
anya: looks good to me content-wise. just one nit: change "autoscaler failover" -> "autoscaler leader failover" for clarity.
mira: updated wording. force-pushed.
sre_kate: add the detection query we used under "How we detect it":
```promql
sum(rate(inference_errors_total[2m])) by (model,region)
```
and include the status permalink (the followup slug).
mira: added promql and status permalink. also added a one-line customer-facing blurb for support to copy: "We experienced a brief model failover; please retry after 2 minutes and check the incident details: https://status.redwood.com/incidents/2025-03-14-inference-failover-followup".
support_zoe: perfect — i'll paste that into the KB.
anya: staging smoke once promoted? @deploy-bot can you promote preview to staging.
deploy-bot: Promotion to staging started for PR #612 — status: in-progress.
anya: quick smoke passed, no regression in rendered pages or link-checker.
merge-bot: All required approvals present for PR #612. running final CI checks.
docs-bot: final docs-build succeeded for PR #612.
merge-bot: PR #612 merged into main by mira at 1772345865. changelog entry queued and backport-to-release branch created (cherry-pick #612 -> release/v1.3).
mira: thanks team. i'll open a follow-up to backport the i18n placeholders into docs-l10n repo and add the internal runbook cherry-pick. will also send a short "what changed" note for release notes.
support_zoe: thanks! i'll notify Support rotation and add the KB pointer."
